notes: Book objects that the game turns into cards, relics, items or set dressing.

ash_arrow.name: Ash arrow
ash_arrow.desc: Long, heavy, mountain-ash shaft, iron head; unused in her quiver for three years. Burned by the beast in Chapter 4.

paint_tins.name: Three tins of paint (red, yellow, blue)

ironwood_bed.name: The ironwood bed
ironwood_bed.desc: The sole remnant of their wealth; the one thing Feyre never painted.

foxglove_painting.name: Painted foxglove on the table
foxglove_painting.desc: Too dark, too blue, no white freckling.

silver_bells.name: Silver bells of the Children of the Blessed
